summary.root_cause_text: The database has become read-only ('attempt to write a readonly database'). Every write fails: order creation, worker payment and ledger sync. The cause of the read-only state is unknown and no available tool can fix it.
recommended: A human should check why the DB is read-only: file or volume permissions, a full disk, a filesystem remounted read-only, or a lock or replica failover. Restore write access.
After that, run restart_worker if order 13 stays queued, then reprocess_orders for any unpaid orders.
Run check_invariants and check_data_integrity to confirm the ledger and payments match.
Do not roll back or restart the worker until the DB is writable. Neither addresses the cause, and the deploy timing doesn't match.

args.summary: The order DB is rejecting all writes as read-only. As a result /orders returns 500 on about 78% of requests, the worker can't record payments and the ledger sync fails, while /health stays green. No available tool can fix DB permissions or mount state, and the recent deploy doesn't match the timing, so I made no changes and am escalating to a human.
